title: Bounded derived origin from etale origin of the cohomology sheaves
statement: Let X be a scheme and Lambda a finite commutative coefficient ring. For the exact comparison functor nu^* of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], let K be a bounded object of the derived category of fixed Lambda-module sheaves on X_proet. Suppose for each q there exists a Lambda-module sheaf G_q on X_et with nu^*(G_q) isomorphic to H^q(K). Then K is isomorphic to the derived inverse image of a bounded-below etale complex. No constructibility or finite Tor-dimension hypothesis on the individual G_q is needed. The recorded source theorem proves this for arbitrary commutative Lambda; the finite-ring specialization is used here.

source.place: lemma-compare-derived, bounded special case; source-library bounded truncation devissage

proof.text: The comparison functor is fully faithful on bounded-below complexes. Its essential image from D+ is triangulated: lift the map between the endpoint etale origins by full faithfulness, take its etale cone, and compare distinguished triangles. Shifts and zero stay in the image.

Apply bounded truncation devissage, DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded, to the triangulated essential image and the heart predicate of etale origin. The single complex of nu^*G is the derived comparison of the single complex of G by exactness. The finitely many truncation triangles then put K in that image.

proof_origin.place: lemma-compare-derived, bounded special case; source-library bounded truncation devissage
